nodes.label: Feature: GLUE Cloud: accounts, GLUE Home and devices
nodes.rationale: Optional Cloudflare Worker tier. You sign in with Google/Apple, run GLUE Home on your main computer, and browse its collection from other devices. WebRTC streams songs, direct or through TURN relay. Signed in, every collection syncs (shared form, one per account). GLUE Home 0.59+ is the library engine; the website on that computer is only its screen. The page does no sync, analysis, repairs or duplicates when GLUE Home runs.
